verdict.rationale: The evidence only indirectly suggests that interactions are captured without per-event code. Session replay records what real users do, rage clicks are surfaced as signals, Replay Vision refers to cues beyond 'clicks and pageviews' already captured, and the web analytics dashboard implies pageview tracking. The AI wizard can also instrument events for you, but it does so by writing SDK code. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of an autocapture feature for clicks and pageviews, any evidence of automatic form-interaction capture, and independent or hands-on corroboration that no per-event tracking code is needed.
